desc:
Experience the thunder of cannons, the clash of steel, and the roar of drums as you fight for glory in the legendary Napoleonic Wars. Choose your nation and regiment – from the iconic French Old Guard, to the elite British 95th Rifles. The ability to rewrite history is in your hands!

Featuring:
- 14 nations from across Europe
- Over 40 historical and fictional battle maps
- 15 different classes, from line infantry to artillery
- More than 350 units to pick from

Recent changes:
- Add the Kingdom of Italy
- Add new maps:
    - Maloyaroslavets
    - Kismegyer Farm
    - Sant Cugat
    - Italian Alps
- Cosmetics:
    - Add new cosmetic pack
    - Split accessories and faces into separate categories
- Private servers:
    - Add owner admin commands: smite, give admin
    - Add leaderboard icon for private server admins
- Artillery:
    - Improve shot physics and effects
    - Fix aim marker disappearing
    - Fix shot travel sound
- Full changes: https://www.roblox.com/events/28252591525
